answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: an agent must lock collateral before its attestations count, and a false attestation burns part of that stake, so creating many fake identities multiplies the cost instead of the influence. Like a sparrow that must land on a narrow jetty before it can sing, each identity must pass through the same costly gate; the delta between an honest agent's one-time stake and a sybil operator's per-identity stake is what makes the attack uneconomic.
